name: non-matching wikilinks are preserved byte-identical on rewrite
description: In a file with both a matching and several non-matching wikilinks, only the matching one is rewritten. The non-matching links are returned byte-identical even when denormalised ([[./unrelated.md]], [[also/]]) — normalisation happens only as a side effect of an actual rewrite, never on links left alone (DESIGN §4.3).
